d: India's biggest bottled water brand, Bisleri, is facing a major food safety setback after the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) reportedly found a sample of its drinking water unsafe. The regulator plans to conduct further tests on Bisleri samples collected nationwide and expand inspections to other packaged drinking water companies. FSSAI has also announced legal proceedings against the company. Bisleri, meanwhile, maintains that its water is safe for consumption and says it follows stringent quality-control standards.
